abstract: In our attempts at establishing a cancer cell line from various ascites of cancer bearing patients, a cell line was successfully established from the ascites of a 63-year-old female with primary ovarian tumor (embryonal carcinoma). Histological findings of the peritoneum, due to metastasis, appeared to be cystadenocarcinoma, revealing the differentiation to non-epithelial cells which formed coarse networks and fibers, and morphologic changes of tissue cultures also reflected such histologic findings. At present the subculture has reached the 95th population doubling level, and cultured cells have assumed the morphology of mesothelial cells or fibroblasts with about 50 chromosomes. As a human malignant cell line, it is useful for the study of human malignant tumor cell.
abstract_ja: 63歳女性の原発性卵巣胎児性癌（embryonal carcinoma）患者の腹水から、悪性細胞株の樹立に成功した。腹膜の組織学的所見は転移によるものと思われ、嚢胞腺癌に見えた。培養細胞は、粗い網目状と線維を形成する非上皮性細胞への分化を示し、組織培養の形態変化もこの組織学的所見を反映していた。継代は現在95回の集団倍加レベルに達しており、培養細胞は中皮細胞または線維芽細胞の形態をとり、染色体数は約50本であった。ヒト悪性細胞株として、ヒト悪性腫瘍細胞の研究に有用である。
